text: Given the persistent supraclavicular lymphadenopathy, systemic "B symptoms" (night sweats, weight loss), and elevated LDH, this strongly points toward a lymphoproliferative disorder. Did you experience any unintentional weight loss over the last few months, and have you noticed any skin rash or persistent itching?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Hodgkin Lymphoma.

The combination of supraclavicular lymphadenopathy, significant B symptoms (fever, night sweats, weight loss), elevated LDH, and abdominal pain is highly concerning for an advanced lymphoproliferative disorder, likely Hodgkin lymphoma given the classic presentation. I recommend requesting CT images of the chest, abdomen, and pelvis to stage the disease immediately.
